checkpoint_finding.future_project_fit_rule: A fit on any development source is continual_seen for that source. Record exact P/R/C records, biological replicate rows, preprocessing, training-only vocabularies, architecture, loss, optimizer, validation partition, seeds, and artifact hashes.

external_corpus_exposure.rule: Any admitted external records become training exposure for their P/R/C symbols and cannot be used as independent test outcomes.

preprocessing_and_evaluation_incidents.finding: Default transcriptomics preprocessing can normalize, log-transform, and select HVGs on all observations before a later split.
Default aggregation can collapse all biological replicates sharing perturbation, context, and split into one mean.
The fallback split is by perturbation symbol and does not implement project locus, guide-family, context, and replicate grouping.
The released encoding path silently maps an unknown perturbation symbol to the control code.
Core LPM has no released external embedding path for a wholly unseen noncoding perturbation symbol.

prediction_first_rule.gse313774: An unseen liver-chip context C and mismatched intervention P cannot be added to the vocabulary after outcomes are opened. No current LPM prediction is eligible for this stress test; CXCL1 and IL8 remain excluded.

remaining_blockers: Do not schedule LPM for the current GSE281160 held-symbol task; register a separate in-vocabulary combination task if scientifically useful.
Resolve GSE281160 biological replicates, custom reference, guide-to-locus table, matrix layer, P/R/C schema, and output scale.
Implement split-before-preprocessing, replicate-preserving conversion, strict unknown P/R/C rejection, deterministic checkpoint naming, and safe state-dict loading.
If paper corpora are used, separately freeze exact files, versions, rights, biological units, identifiers, and checksums.
Freeze project architecture, optimizer, validation rule, seeds, vocabularies, weights, and prediction hashes.
Pass isolated runtime, resume, numeric, and leakage fixtures.

systema_audit.rule: For a supported task, the independent evaluator reconstructs full absolute-expression vectors and computes O_pert only from training perturbation-specific replicate centroids; residualization cannot supply unknown P or C symbols.
